summary: Frontend-only validation of the new dedicated 'Transports autour de moi' screen + 'Réserver un VTC jusqu'à cet arrêt'. All requested data-testids present and behaviour matches spec. GTFS Martinique real stops (POINTE SIMON, ALMADIES BO KANNAL, Pont Francisco) are shown with real bus lines & theoretical departures. Far-note correctly triggers when geoloc is set to Iowa. VTC booking from a stop navigates to /course with dlat/dlng/daddr properly prefilled in the URL and the destination is visibly bound on the next screen.

integration_issues.flow: Réserver un VTC vers un arrêt → /course
integration_issues.issue: When destination is pre-filled via dlat/dlng/daddr query params, RideChoosePage immediately skips the dropoff input step and renders the vehicle selection screen. As a result, the input element with data-testid=ride-choose-dropoff is NOT mounted (count=0). The destination IS prefilled (URL contains daddr=A%C3%A9roport%20P%C3%B4le%20Cara%C3%AFbes, header displays 'Aéroport Pôle Caraïbes', state initialized in useState). This matches expected behaviour functionally but does not satisfy the literal spec line 'Vérifier sur la page /course que le champ destination (data-testid=ride-choose-dropoff) est pré-rempli avec le nom de l'arrêt'. The data-testid could be added to the destination header chip to make it explicitly assertable.

action_items: OPTIONAL/COSMETIC: Add data-testid=ride-choose-dropoff (or a sibling testid like ride-choose-dropoff-display) on the visible 'DESTINATION' header chip in RideChoosePage so automated tests can directly assert the prefilled destination text when the input is no longer mounted. Functionality is correct as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: NearbyTransitPage.js — clean, focused (~207 lines), uses transportAPI, proper fallback to Fort-de-France with triedFallback ref and far-note announcement, all interactive elements properly testid'd.
NearbyTransitMap.jsx — small (~57 lines), uses shared GMAPS_LOADER_OPTIONS, cleans overlays on every render, fitBounds wrapped in try/catch.

RideChoosePage.js initializes dropoff from query params correctly (lines 86-92). When both pickup (auto-located) and dropoff are set, the UI auto-progresses; the dropoff input is unmounted — consider keeping a testid on the destination display element to ease automation.
test_credentials: Client: test2@example.com / TestPass123! (role user) — login via /login/email (data-testid email-login-page).
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing GTFS Martinique data (3329 stops imported per agent context).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: /login/email page with [data-testid=email-input]+[data-testid=password-input]+[data-testid=email-login-submit-btn]. After login, role=user lands on /home. /transports-autour is a ProtectedRoute (role user). Preview-env geolocation defaults to outside Martinique → page auto-recenters to Fort-de-France (14.6036,-61.0730) and renders [data-testid=far-note] + real GTFS stops. To force the far-note path explicitly, set context.set_geolocation to Iowa (41.878,-93.097) and grant 'geolocation' permission. When VTC is booked from a stop, /course?mode=standard&dlat=...&dlng=...&daddr=... auto-skips the dropoff input step, so verify destination via URL params and the 'DESTINATION' header text rather than [data-testid=ride-choose-dropoff] input value.
